productModel.x-citationNote: ESPR 32024R1781 mandates no product data of its own. All three defer to an Art. 4 act, and none is adopted for this category — so this field is anticipated, not required. Verified against the EUR-Lex text.

repairabilityIndex.title: Repairability Index

repairabilityIndex.x-citationNote: Energy-labelling act for smartphones and slate tablets (applies from 20 June 2025). The index is entered in EPREL and drives the label's repairability class; no digital product passport is created. Other electronics: nothing mandates it.

energyEfficiencyClass.x-citationNote: The energy class is discharged by the printed label and the EPREL entry, and only for product groups with a delegated act.

batteryEndurancePerCycle.x-citationNote: Battery endurance per charge cycle (h); declared in EPREL product information sheet. Discharged there, no passport obligation.

batteryEnduranceCycles.x-citationNote: Number of charging cycles used for the battery endurance test; declared in EPREL. Discharged there, no passport obligation.

ratedBatteryCapacity.title: Rated Battery Capacity
ratedBatteryCapacity.x-citationNote: Rated battery capacity (mAh); declared in EPREL product information sheet. Discharged there, no passport obligation.

batteryUserReplaceable.title: Battery User Replaceable
batteryUserReplaceable.description: Whether the battery can be replaced by the end user without professional tools
batteryUserReplaceable.x-citationNote: Battery Regulation Art. 11(1): products incorporating portable batteries must have them readily removable and replaceable by the end-user, using commercially available tools, and come with removal and replacement instructions available online; it applies from 18 February 2027. A design obligation on the product, not passport data, so optional.

ipRating.x-citationNote: IP rating for dust and water resistance (IEC 60529); declared in EPREL. Discharged there, no passport obligation.

disassemblyDepthScore.x-citationNote: Energy-labelling act for smartphones and slate tablets, Annex IV point 5 defines the six weighted sub-scores; Annex V Table 8 is the EPREL product information sheet. No digital product passport created.

dropResistanceTestResult.x-citationNote: Drop resistance test result for smartphones (Annex II B.1.2(1)), declared via ecodesign technical documentation; not an EPREL item and not passport content.

scratchResistanceClass.title: Scratch Resistance Class

batteryMinCycles80Pct.title: Battery Min Cycles at 80%

batteryMinCycles80Pct.x-citationNote: Minimum number of charge/discharge cycles retaining ≥80% initial rated capacity; technical documentation parameter under Annex II B.1.2(4). Not a passport item.

batteryCapacityRetention.title: Battery Capacity Retention
batteryCapacityRetention.description: Battery capacity retention percentage after rated cycles (min 80%)
batteryCapacityRetention.x-citationNote: Battery capacity retention after the stated number of cycles; the 80% threshold is fixed by the test (Annex II B.1.2(4)). Technical documentation parameter; not a passport item.

sparePartsList.title: Spare Parts List
sparePartsList.description: List of available spare parts (15 for professionals, 5 for end-users)
sparePartsList.x-citationNote: Spare-parts availability lists are mandated for specific ecodesign product groups (smartphones and tablets under Reg (EU) 2023/1670; displays under 2019/2021) via Dir 2009/125/EC, and are made available to professional repairers rather than published as passport data. No such duty applies to electronics generally.

sparePartsAvailabilityYears.title: Spare Parts Availability (Years)
sparePartsAvailabilityYears.description: Years spare parts remain available after the date of end of placement on the market (placing of the last unit), not end of production (at least 7 for smartphones and tablets)
sparePartsAvailabilityYears.x-citationNote: Minimum spare-parts availability periods are set per ecodesign product group — seven years after the last unit for smartphones and tablets under Reg (EU) 2023/1670. The duty is to keep the parts available, discharged toward professional repairers; the period is not a mandated passport field.

maxDeliveryDays.title: Max Delivery Days
maxDeliveryDays.description: Maximum working days to deliver a spare part after the order is received: 5 during the first 5 years of the spare-part availability period, 10 during the remaining 2 years (Reg. (EU) 2023/1670, smartphones and slate tablets)
maxDeliveryDays.x-citationNote: Ecodesign requirement for smartphones and slate tablets under Reg. (EU) 2023/1670, applying from 20 June 2025: spare parts are delivered within 5 working days of the order during the first 5 years of the availability period and within 10 working days during the remaining 2 years. It binds the product design and the manufacturer's conduct; no provision puts it in a product passport, so optional.

sparePartsWebsiteUrl.title: Spare Parts Website URL

sparePartsWebsiteUrl.x-citationNote: ESPR 32024R1781 mandates no product data of its own. Art. 7(1) makes information requirements those 'laid down in the delegated acts adopted pursuant to Article 4'; Art. 9(2) says those acts 'shall … specify' what a passport carries; and Art. 27 binds manufacturers only 'when placing products COVERED BY a delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 4' on the market. Operative instrument for this field: Reg. 2023/1670.

priceList.title: Spare Parts Price List
priceList.description: URL or document reference for spare parts pricing
priceList.x-citationNote: Ecodesign requirement for smartphones and slate tablets under Reg. (EU) 2023/1670, applying from 20 June 2025: indicative pre-tax prices of the spare parts, at least in euro, are published on the free-access website for the availability period. It binds the product design and the manufacturer's conduct; no provision puts it in a product passport, so optional.

osUpdateSupportYears.title: OS Update Support (Years)
osUpdateSupportYears.description: Minimum guaranteed years of operating-system updates (security, corrective and functionality), counted from the date of end of placement on the market, i.e. when the last unit of the model is placed on the market (at least 5 for smartphones and tablets)
osUpdateSupportYears.x-citationNote: Ecodesign requirement under Dir. 2009/125/EC, applies from 20 June 2025; the declared years also feed the Reg. 2023/1669 SSU score and EPREL item 19. No passport created.

osUpdateEndDate.title: OS Update End Date
osUpdateEndDate.description: Last date when OS updates will be provided
osUpdateEndDate.x-citationNote: Ecodesign requirement under Dir. 2009/125/EC, applies from 20 June 2025. No passport created.

firmwareAccessForRepairers.title: Firmware Access for Repairers
firmwareAccessForRepairers.description: Whether firmware/software tools are accessible to independent repair professionals
firmwareAccessForRepairers.x-citationNote: Ecodesign requirement for smartphones and slate tablets under Reg. (EU) 2023/1670, applying from 20 June 2025: where spare parts are serialised, professional repairers (and end-users for point 1(c) parts) get non-discriminatory access to the software tools and firmware needed for full functionality, within 3 working days of the request. It binds the product design and the manufacturer's conduct; no provision puts it in a product passport, so optional.

dataWipeFunction.title: Data Wipe Function
dataWipeFunction.description: Whether the device supports a complete factory data wipe function
dataWipeFunction.x-citationNote: Ecodesign requirement for smartphones and slate tablets under Reg. (EU) 2023/1670, applying from 20 June 2025: devices include a function that resets them to factory settings and securely erases the encryption key (point (a) requires user data to be encrypted by default). It binds the product design and the manufacturer's conduct; no provision puts it in a product passport, so optional.

dataTransferSupport.title: Data Transfer Support
dataTransferSupport.description: Whether the device supports data transfer/migration to a new device
dataTransferSupport.x-citationNote: No act in force requires it. Reg. (EU) 2023/1670 Annex II B.1.1(6) requires encryption by default and a secure factory reset, not data migration; ESPR Annex I point (c) (ease of reuse) is the parameter a future delegated act could use.

psuEfficiency10.title: PSU Efficiency at 10% Load
psuEfficiency10.description: Power supply unit efficiency at 10% of rated output
psuEfficiency10.x-citationNote: Annex II point 3.1(e) names PSU efficiency at 10%, 20%, 50% and 100% of rated output power, expressed in % to one decimal place, as information manufacturers must provide. It must be published in the instruction manuals and on the manufacturer's, authorised representative's and importer's FREE-ACCESS WEBSITES, from placing on the market until at least eight years after the last unit of the model. A passport is a legitimate way to discharge that publication duty, though the act does not name one. Applies from 1 March 2020 to servers and online data storage products, except custom-made one-off units.

psuEfficiency20.description: Power supply unit efficiency at 20% of rated output

idleStatePower.x-citationNote: Annex II point 3.1(h) requires idle state power in Watts to one decimal place, and 3.1(l) the same at the higher boundary temperature of the declared operating condition class. It must be published in the instruction manuals and on the manufacturer's, authorised representative's and importer's FREE-ACCESS WEBSITES, from placing on the market until at least eight years after the last unit of the model. A passport is a legitimate way to discharge that publication duty, though the act does not name one. activeStateEfficiency.title: Active State Efficiency

activeStateEfficiency.x-citationNote: Annex II point 3.1(m) requires the active state efficiency and the performance in active state of the server. It must be published in the instruction manuals and on the manufacturer's, authorised representative's and importer's FREE-ACCESS WEBSITES, from placing on the market until at least eight years after the last unit of the model. A passport is a legitimate way to discharge that publication duty, though the act does not name one. Applies from 1 March 2020 to servers and online data storage products, except custom-made one-off units.

operatingConditionsClass.title: Operating Conditions Class

operatingConditionsClass.x-citationNote: Annex II point 3.1(k) requires the declared operating condition class as detailed in the Annex's Table 6. It must be published in the instruction manuals and on the manufacturer's, authorised representative's and importer's FREE-ACCESS WEBSITES, from placing on the market until at least eight years after the last unit of the model. A passport is a legitimate way to discharge that publication duty, though the act does not name one. operatingTemperatureRange.title: Operating Temperature Range

operatingTemperatureRange.x-citationNote: The temperature range follows from the Annex II point 3.1(k) declared operating condition class, and 3.1(l) requires idle state power at that class's higher boundary temperature. The class is the mandated datum; the range expresses it.

productType.title: Server Product Type
productType.description: Physical form factor of the server
productType.x-citationNote: Annex II point 3.1(a) requires the product type. It must be published in the instruction manuals and on the manufacturer's, authorised representative's and importer's FREE-ACCESS WEBSITES, from placing on the market until at least eight years after the last unit of the model. A passport is a legitimate way to discharge that publication duty, though the act does not name one. Applies from 1 March 2020 to servers and online data storage products, except custom-made one-off units.

processorSockets.title: Processor Sockets
processorSockets.description: Number of CPU sockets on the server
processorSockets.x-citationNote: The Annex II point 3.1 information list does not enumerate processor sockets. The closest mandated items are 3.1(i), the list of components attracting additional idle power allowances, and 3.1(p), the configurations represented by a product-family model. A socket count is useful configuration detail rather than a required datum.

installedProcessors.title: Installed Processors
installedProcessors.x-citationNote: Not enumerated in the Annex II point 3.1 information list. It is relevant to 3.1(i) idle-power allowances and to the low-end/high-end product-family configurations that 3.1 requires be reported, but is not itself a mandated field.

memoryModules.title: Memory Modules
memoryModules.x-citationNote: Additional memory is named in Annex II point 3.1(i) only as a component attracting an additional idle power allowance. The module inventory itself is not a mandated disclosure.

totalMemory.title: Total Memory
totalMemory.x-citationNote: Not enumerated in the Annex II point 3.1 information list; memory appears there as a driver of idle power allowances under 3.1(i) rather than as a declared capacity.

storageDevices.title: Storage Devices
storageDevices.x-citationNote: HDDs and SSDs are named in Annex II point 3.1(i) as components attracting additional idle power allowances. The device inventory is not itself a mandated disclosure, though data storage devices are one of the components that must remain disassemblable under point 1.2.1.

totalStorageCapacity.title: Total Storage Capacity
totalStorageCapacity.x-citationNote: Not enumerated in the Annex II point 3.1 information list. Storage appears there only through the idle-power allowances of 3.1(i).

powerSupplyUnits.title: Power Supply Units
powerSupplyUnits.description: Number of power supply units installed
powerSupplyUnits.x-citationNote: An additional PSU is named in Annex II point 3.1(i) as attracting an idle power allowance, and where a model belongs to a server product family 3.1(g) requires all PSUs offered in that family to be reported with their efficiency and power factor. A bare unit count is not itself mandated.

expansionSlots.title: Expansion Slots
expansionSlots.description: Number of available expansion slots (PCIe etc.)
expansionSlots.x-citationNote: Not enumerated in the Annex II point 3.1 information list. Expansion and graphics cards appear in point 1.2.1 as components that must remain disassemblable, and additional I/O devices in 3.1(i) as an idle-power allowance.

dataStorageRemovable.title: Data Storage Removable
dataStorageRemovable.description: Whether data storage devices can be removed without soldering
dataStorageRemovable.x-citationNote: Data storage devices are point 1.2.1(a). That point is a DESIGN requirement: from 1 March 2020 manufacturers must ensure joining, fastening or sealing techniques do not prevent its disassembly for repair or reuse. The duty is to build it that way, not to declare that you did. What must be published is the disassembly INSTRUCTIONS under Annex II point 3.3, and those go to registered repairers and recyclers rather than the public.

secureDataDeletion.title: Secure Data Deletion

recycledRareEarth.title: Recycled Rare Earth Content
recycledRareEarth.description: Total percentage of recycled rare earth elements in the product
recycledRareEarth.x-citationNote: ESPR Annex I point (h) lists 'use or content of recycled materials and recovery of materials, including critical raw materials' among the parameters a delegated act may use; no delegated act is adopted for electronics. CRMA Art. 29 asks for recycled shares of eight magnet elements only (Nd, Dy, Pr, Tb, B, Sm, Ni, Co), per element, so it does not cover this field.

postConsumerRecycledShare.title: Post-Consumer Recycled Share
postConsumerRecycledShare.x-citationNote: ESPR 32024R1781 mandates no product data of its own. Art. 7(1) makes information requirements those 'laid down in the delegated acts adopted pursuant to Article 4'; Art. 9(2) says those acts 'shall … specify' what a passport carries; and Art. 27 binds manufacturers only 'when placing products COVERED BY a delegated act adopted pursuant to Article 4' on the market. All three defer to an Art. 4 act, and none is adopted for this category — so this field is anticipated, not required. Verified against the EUR-Lex text. Operative instrument for this field: ESPR 2024/1781.

weeeCategory.title: WEEE Category
weeeCategory.x-citationNote: WEEE Annex III defines the six EEE categories used from 15 August 2018, and they matter for producer registration and reporting to the national WEEE register — 27 national registers, not a Union database. No provision requires publishing the category number as product data; the consumer-facing WEEE duty is the crossed-out wheeled bin mark.

productWeight.title: Product Weight
productWeight.description: Net weight of the product as placed on the market, in kg: the product with every part supplied with it (a TV's stand, detachable feet, batteries or remote control shipped in the box), excluding packaging. This is the basis WEEE placed-on-market reporting uses. It is TracePass's field definition, not a legal one. When a spec sheet gives several weights ("set weight with stand" vs "without stand", or "package weight"), use the with-stand figure and never the package weight.
productWeight.x-citationNote: WEEE Art. 16 and Annex X Part B(4) make producers report the 'quantity of EEE placed on the national market, by weight' to the national register, per EEE category. An aggregate reporting duty, not a per-product passport item; this field records the product's contribution to it.

dismantlingInstructions.title: Dismantling Instructions
dismantlingInstructions.description: URL to instructions for dismantling/recycling the product
dismantlingInstructions.x-citationNote: WEEE Art. 15(1): producers provide information free of charge on preparation for re-use and treatment of each new type of EEE, within one year of placing it on the market, to the re-use centres and treatment and recycling facilities that need it. A duty to inform those facilities, not public passport data, so optional.

accessLevel.title: Access Rights
accessLevel.description: Default access level for the DPP data
accessLevel.x-citationNote: ESPR Art. 10 governs the passport's TECHNICAL design — data carrier, unique identifiers, access rights, availability — not which product data must be published. The substantive obligation still arrives via an Art. 4 delegated act, and none is adopted for this category. Anticipated; voluntary today. Verified against the EUR-Lex text. Operative instrument for this field: ESPR 2024/1781.

ceMarkingStatus.title: CE Marking Status
ceMarkingStatus.description: Whether the product bears CE marking and its validity
ceMarkingStatus.x-citationNote: The CE marking is affixed to the equipment; the law knows only whether it is affixed, so this status duplicates ceMarking. No adopted act creates a passport for this category, so nothing here is passport-mandatory.
